g.text: History replay at the model-derived 44.66 GB budget
Each point: median of 6 traces from one process; F/R show order variation, not confidence intervals.
Forward spans 2 processes; reverse spans 1. Reuse excludes the first W compulsory misses.
Hit curves overlap exactly: Raw = Native; Gather = Fused; F = R.
48-layer read/restore replay; model inference and outbound encoding excluded.
